verses.1: Thirdly, I come to you now. All the offerings will be placed on the lips of two elders and three other people.
verses.2: I have also warned and said that, from now on, both those who have been deceived before and all others, I will not go back there again.
verses.3: Since you are to test the one who speaks through me, Jesus. He does not weaken in you, but is strong among you.
verses.4: For he was crucified because of our weakness, but he still lives by the power of God. Just as we also become weak in him, yet we live with him by the power of God for your sake.
verses.5: You try to test yourselves, whether or not it’s true in your faith. Do you not know that Jesus Christ is among you? If not, then you are unfaithful.
verses.6: I hope that you will understand that we are not completely incompetent.
verses.7: We hope that the God will not do you any harm. It’s not that we want to appear to be worthy of His favor, but rather, that you should do what is good, and we will remain unworthy of His favor.
verses.8: For we do not strive for truth itself, but rather for the sake of truth.
verses.9: We rejoice when we are weak, for you, on the other hand, remain strong. This is what we desire: your help in this task.
verses.10: Therefore, I write these things down, so that I may not misuse the authority that the Lord has given me, for building houses and not for other purposes.
verses.11: So, brothers, rejoice, be happy, please consider this carefully. Let us live in peace and harmony. May the God of love and peace be with you.
verses.12: You have taken up each other in a holy act of love. All the saints will take up you in this holy act of love.
verses.13: The grace of Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship with the Holy Spirit, along with all of you.
